$comment: The per-model registry. Data only: the Pi extension and the Python adapter read this; neither defines its own copy. `tool_names` is the canonical set of tool names the extension may register - the contract is the source of truth, and the extension checks its registered tools against it. `lobes_role` is a lobes role name, never a checkpoint id. `endpoint.default_base_url` is the OpenAI-compatible base URL used when ASSOCIATE_BASE_URL is unset (the local lobes gateway). `reasoning` is interpreted by the provider layer: model-default sends no override, on marks the model reasoning-capable, off sends the off switch for that model only. `gated_tools` (deviations d6/r17 and d7) are tools that are not repo mutations but still pass the CLEF safety gate for EVERY model, senses included: a memory write (eidetic_remember) and the web tools (web_search, web_page, which can send data off the machine) are not reads, so the read-only fallback refuses them when CLEF and Super are both unreachable. A gated tool is never also in `mutating_tools`, because a may_mutate=false model is refused every mutating call before the gate. `run_tests` (deviation d12) runs only the test commands the operator configured for the run (ASSOCIATE_TEST_COMMANDS); it executes repository code, so it is a mutating tool (never held by senses, always gated). `prompt_file` is checked for shape only; the files land with the prompts task.
